evidence.arabic: أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوا أَن يَقُولُوا آمَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Do the people think that they will be left to say, 'We believe' and they will not be tried?

evidence.arabic: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُم بِشَيْءٍ مِّنَ الْخَوْفِ وَالْجُوعِ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَنفُسِ وَالثَّمَرَاتِ
evidence.translation_en: And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits.

evidence.arabic: الَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالُوا إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Who, when disaster strikes them, say, 'Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.'

evidence.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
evidence.translation_en: It is He who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deed.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it, that We may test them as to which of them is best in deed.

sub_sections.heading: What does the Quran say about the reward of tests?

evidence.arabic: أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy. And it is those who are the rightly guided.

evidence.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا
evidence.translation_en: O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed.

evidence.arabic: وَلِيَبْتَلِيَ اللَّهُ مَا فِي صُدُورِكُمْ وَلِيُمَحِّصَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ
evidence.translation_en: And that Allah may test what is in your chests and purify what is in your hearts.

evidence.arabic: وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ
evidence.translation_en: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you and the patient.

evidence.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِالشَّرِّ وَالْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً
evidence.translation_en: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial.

evidence.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْكَاذِبِينَ
evidence.translation_en: And We have certainly tested those before them. And Allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.

evidence.arabic: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ فَإِذَا أُوذِيَ فِي اللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللَّهِ
evidence.translation_en: And among the people are those who say, ‘We believe in Allah,’ but when they are harmed for the sake of Allah, they treat the persecution of people as if it were the punishment of Allah.

evidence.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
evidence.translation_en: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.

evidence.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا آتَاهَا
evidence.translation_en: Allah does not burden a soul except with what He has given it.

evidence.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
evidence.translation_en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease.

evidence.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
evidence.translation_en: And We do not burden a soul except with what it can bear.

evidence.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
evidence.translation_en: And We do not burden a soul except with what it can bear.

sections.heading: What to do in the test

evidence.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
evidence.translation_en: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

evidence.arabic: وَعَسَىٰ أَن تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَعَسَىٰ أَن تُحِبُّوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ
evidence.translation_en: And perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you.

evidence.arabic: إِن يَنصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ
evidence.translation_en: If Allah should help you, none can overcome you.

evidence.arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَانَا ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Say, 'Never will we be struck except by what Allah has decreed for us; He is our protector.' And upon Allah let the believers rely.

evidence.arabic: وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ
evidence.translation_en: And whoever believes in Allah, He will guide his heart.
